title: Japanese Oat Stir Fry
description: A unique Japanese-inspired stir fry dish made with oats, perfect as a quick breakfast or snack.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add sliced onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 4-5 minutes.
Add oats and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently, until the oats are lightly toasted.
Stir in soy sauce and sugar. Cook for an additional 1 minute.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions if desired.
